Name of Test Case: Filter serving teams by keyword search
Action to Take: Type 'worship' into ministry search input field.
Expected Outcome: List filters instantly to ministries containing 'worship' in name, description, or category.
Displays only ministries where unfilled volunteer slots are 35% or higher, with urgent badge.

Name of Test Case: Expand ministry card to inspect team leader and roles
Action to Take: Click on 'Kids Ministry' card in the serving grid.
Expected Outcome: Detailed drawer opens showing team description, time commitments, and ministry leader contact.

Name of Test Case: Bookmark recommended ministry to saved shortlist
Action to Take: Click 'Save to shortlist' bookmark icon on 'Worship Collective' recommendation card.
Expected Outcome: Ministry is added to local saved list; navigation badge count increments by 1.
Displays all bookmarked serving opportunities with option to submit interest request.

Name of Test Case: Staff view of filed volunteer connection requests
Action to Take: Sign in as staff and open '#/serve/saved' requests queue.
Expected Outcome: Staff sees full list of member-submitted volunteer inquiries and chat connection requests.

Action to Take: Click 'Connect' checkmark button on a pending volunteer request.
Expected Outcome: Calls PATCH /requests/:id with status 'connected'; moves request to active connections list.

Name of Test Case: Staff archives or deletes processed request
Action to Take: Click 'Remove' trash icon on an archived volunteer request.
Expected Outcome: Calls DELETE /requests/:id; removes request card from staff queue view.

Name of Test Case: AI volunteer matching with single-word generic input
Action to Take: On volunteer finder, enter single word 'anything' into gifts input and click 'Find matching places'.
Expected Outcome: Prompts user to specify gifts/skills or provides general serving opportunities.

Name of Test Case: Real-time staff queue update across multiple browser sessions
Action to Take: Visitor files a volunteer request in chat; observe staff queue on a separate un-refreshed staff browser.
Expected Outcome: Staff queue updates automatically via WebSocket or background push without manual reload.
